# Semantic head stage: working parameter routes, visual failures retained

Commit deabfc0cb3b46fddb8637ce15693acb610d68e0f was tested by GitHub Actions run 37601927997. Chromium and WebKit passed all 19 head-state geometry/repeat/archive/render tests, the prior body/native tests and the desktop UI tests. Runtime loading was 3036 ms / 1422 ms on those CI runners. Chromium reported 254 MB JS heap after load; this is not process peak RAM. WebKit exposes no equivalent heap API.

The 124 native expression fields (Anny 52 and MHR 72) were individually exercised with active source ownership. Those numerical response checks do not establish complete visual quality. Anny native eye-bone transforms are used for rig gaze, while its eye-look expression drives a real separate 72-vertex native eye component. MHR native eyesLook surface fields are retained; no invented rigid eyeball angle is used.

Actual browser screenshots show an unresolved adult tongue/lower-lip intersection at jawOpen=.6 and tongueOut=1, plus cavity/teeth overlap during opening. The exact native Anny input also has 60 tongue/main-skin triangle crossings. The common surface has 121 exterior-lip/tongue crossing pairs; counts cannot be compared as geometric severity because topology densities differ. Same-camera teacher images and explicit cross-component predicates are retained. Existing GNM neutral geometry already has internal eye/cavity/dental overlaps, so new face-pair counts alone cannot certify a visible defect.

Baby/newborn are exact official age=0 / age=-1/3 inputs. Their source facial shape changes are applied once, but adult GNM dentition is not a validated infant mouth. Infant dental development and ear detail remain unaccepted. No public full-function readiness or age-fidelity claim follows from the parameter route tests.

Development contact ablations are isolated files and do not change the tested runtime. The source observation archive and generator scripts are preserved so a container loss cannot erase this checkpoint. Public R01 and all teacher baselines remain unchanged.
